correctness.rationale: Each branch maps [0,1/2] onto [0,1] with |F'|=θ+A(1+β)t^β≥θ+(2−θ)(1+β)>1 and inverse Jacobian 1/p of bounded variation. Full-branch expanding-map BV theory gives the normalized invariant h. Preimage jump contributions in h=P^n h decay by Λ^(−n)Var(h), proving continuity at the interior cusp; a positive-measure continuity interval and a full inverse cylinder show h(c)>0. Transfer invariance yields h(1−δ)=[h(c−t)+h(c+t)]/[θ+A(1+β)t^β], δ=θt+At^(1+β); t~(δ/A)^(1/(1+β)), hence h(1−δ)~2h(c)δ^γ/[(1+β)A^(1/(1+β))], γ=−β/(1+β)∈(0,1). A W^{2,1} density has finite endpoint derivative, inconsistent with h(1−δ)/δ→∞. Checks cover β endpoints only as limits, not values. Independent local P1 inverse-asymptotic numerical tests confirmed powers but are not invariant-density proof.
